The '''''Freebooter''''' was the second [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Devon Fuller]] during his allegiance to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Fuller gained possession of the ''Freebooter'' after his previous ship, a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] named the ''[[Croc of Gold]]'', was destroyed in a clash with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces over [[Tashtor Seneca]].<ref name="GG9" /> Sometime before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="date" /> the ''Freebooter'' suffered a similar fate: it was wrecked by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] when the Imperial ship [[Attack on Ansarra Rebel base|attacked]] the [[Ansarra Rebel base]]. Fuller did not [[Death/Legends|perish]] in the destruction of the ''Freebooter'', and the Alliance loaned to him a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] called ''[[The Solar Flair]]'', so that he could continue to work on their behalf.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Freebooter'' was mentioned in the [[1993]] reference book ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" />
